Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers reported revenue from operations of INR121 crores for Q1 FY27, marking a 60% year-on-year growth. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%, while Profit After Tax was INR9 crores. Management detailed upcoming retail store expansions including Surat in Q2 FY27 and Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar in Q3 FY27, alongside strategic shifts towards retail scaling and progressive inventory hedging via Gold Metal Loans. RBZ Jewellers Limited released its earnings presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting an operational revenue of INR 1,208 million and a PAT of INR 91 million. Management highlighted ongoing retail expansion plans across major Gujarat hubs including Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar.

guidance.claim: The company expects the B2B to B2C revenue mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two.
guidance.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the long-term revenue mix will be 75% retail and 25% B2B.
guidance.quote: and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: The company projects that debt-to-equity ratio will remain below 1:1 at approximately 0.8 by the end of the financial year.
guidance.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

guidance.claim: Retail expansion is on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
guidance.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumer demand for Q1 FY27 was robust, driven by higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the IIJS trade show received a very warm response with buyer growth and good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects retail and wholesale demand to remain positive and promising for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch the Surat store in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Maninagar and Gandhinagar stores are both scheduled to be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores feature a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet with inventory deployment between INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Small format stores have a carpet area of around 5,000 square feet with inventory deployment around INR50 crores plus or minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Amortization of lease assets stood at INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities was at INR115 lakhs for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year FY26, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming in the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to progressively churn inventory over a three-year period to move towards complete hedging using Gold Metal Loans.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started using GML in this quarter, a little bit, but as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

management_commitments.claim: The Surat store will be launched in Quarter 2.
management_commitments.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

management_commitments.claim: Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

management_commitments.claim: Capex break-even for new stores will be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to transition the B2B to B2C revenue mix to 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Both the Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
